blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — All Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) projects nationwide allegedly have kickbacks, its former Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Thursday. Bernardo, a career DPWH official of four decades, made this bombshell revelation when he testified during the former House Speaker Martin Romualdez’s bail hearing for a plunder case over alleged kickbacks worth P7.44 billion. Associate Justice Karl Miranda, Third Division chair, asked if “all DPWH projects have proponents,” and Bernardo replied in affirmative.
